title: Justice Department Files to Intervene and Dismiss Lawsuit that Would Hamper America’s AI Innovation and Security

reading.body:
This incident concerns a power plant built to supply electricity to an AI data center. Environmental groups and civil rights organizations filed legal complaints alleging the facility violated clean air regulations and disproportionately exposed nearby Black communities to pollution. Thermal imaging and air quality monitoring were used to document the violations alleged in notices of intent to sue.

The failure here is deployment without regulatory compliance. An infrastructure project supporting AI operations proceeded without the required air quality permits, according to the filings. A human permitting process, properly enforced, would have caught this before construction or operation began.

It is not established whether the violations alleged in the complaints are factually true, or what the eventual outcome of the litigation will be.
